title: Correspondence coloring with a fixed forbidden subgraph

result.label: Correspondence coloring with a fixed forbidden subgraph
result.statement: Proves the Alon–Krivelevich–Sudakov coloring conjecture in correspondence-coloring form: graphs avoiding any fixed subgraph F need OF( / ) colors when their maximum degree Δ is sufficiently large. Also proves the Ajtai–Erdős–Komlós–Szemerédi independence conjecture: for fixed r ≥ 4, every n -vertex K r -free graph of average degree d ≥ 2 has an independent set of size (n d/d).
